description: This file defines the TailscaleService class responsible for managing Tailscale VPN integration, checking status, and facilitating user actions such as opening the app or the download page. It includes properties for installation status, running status, hostname, IP, and error messages, as well as methods for network communication and app interaction.

classes.name: TailscaleService
classes.description: A singleton class managing Tailscale VPN status checks, app interactions, and providing status properties.

methods.name: checkAppInstallation
methods.description: Checks if the Tailscale app is installed by verifying the application directory.

methods.name: fetchTailscaleStatus
methods.description: Performs an async fetch to the Tailscale API endpoint to retrieve status information.

methods.name: checkTailscaleStatus
methods.description: Asynchronously checks the current Tailscale status, updates internal properties, and triggers fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: openTailscaleApp
methods.description: Opens the Tailscale app if installed.

methods.name: openAppStore
methods.description: Opens the App Store page for Tailscale.

methods.name: openDownloadPage
methods.description: Opens the Tailscale download URL in the browser.

methods.name: openSetupGuide
methods.description: Opens the Tailscale setup instructions URL.
